title: Sycophancy Onset Detection: At What Training Step Does RLHF Induce Sycophancy?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Understanding sycophancy onset informs early stopping heuristics and timing of debiasing interventions. Direct practical value for RLHF practitioners. The GPT-4o rollback incident demonstrates real-world relevance.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Running an RLHF training loop with a synthetic preference dataset requires significant infrastructure setup (PPO, reward model, training loop). Constructing a controlled sycophancy-inducing dataset adds design complexity. Beyond beginner level even with mentoring.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Conceptually clean (one training run, periodic evaluation). But the RLHF setup overhead is substantial. If using an existing RLHF framework, the periodic evaluation and onset identification is manageable. Tight for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
